Choosing the right rental car

Economy cars such as the Suzuki Alto and Wagon R, from PKR 4,000 a day, are the most affordable way to get around Islamabad and Rawalpindi. They suit daily errands, office commutes and short visits.

Sedans such as the Toyota Corolla, Corolla Grande, Yaris, Honda City, Civic and Hyundai Elantra, from PKR 6,000 a day, offer comfort for corporate meetings, family trips and intercity travel on the motorway to Lahore or Peshawar.

SUVs and 4x4s, including the Toyota Prado, Fortuner, Land Cruiser V8, Revo, Kia Sportage, Hyundai Tucson and Honda BR-V, from PKR 7,000 a day, are ideal for protocol duty, VIP guests and tours to Murree, Naran, Skardu and Hunza.

Luxury cars, the Mercedes S400, S500, E250 and C180, Audi A4, A5 and A6 and the Lexus LX 570, from PKR 35,000 a day, are for weddings, VIP guests and protocol duty.

Vans and coasters such as the Toyota Grand Cabin (13 seats) and Coaster (22 or 28 seats), from PKR 15,000 a day, move teams, wedding guests and tour groups together, comfortably and on schedule.
